title: Purpose Icons Manual Redo Batch 01
review_goal: Restart the semantic work from the beginning with the first 5 purpose icons. Show the icon, the current record, and a new interpretation-first proposal before continuing.

items.depicts_observation: Two pairs of rounded vertical bit shapes connected by short lines, arranged in a technical binary-style layout.
items.popular_reading: Binary data or low-level digital values.
items.context_bias: Strongest in developer tools, data inspection, code, or systems contexts.
items.ambiguity_note: Outside technical contexts, some users may only read it as numbers or code decoration.
items.selection_reason: Lucide itself tags this icon with words like code, digits, computer, zero, one, and boolean.

items.depicts_observation: Four small rounded square outlines arranged as modular tiles, with one tile offset at the upper-right.
items.popular_reading: Modules, building blocks, or composable parts.
items.context_bias: Strongest in modular systems, integrations, component libraries, or architecture views.
items.ambiguity_note: It can also read as toy blocks or generic shapes if the surrounding product context is weak.
items.selection_reason: Lucide describes it with words like addon, plugin, integration, extension, package, build, and stack.

items.depicts_observation: A squared chat bubble with a robot-style face, using two short vertical eyes to signal a bot message.
items.context_bias: Strongest in chat, assistant, support, and agent workflows.
items.ambiguity_note: It could be read more generally as bot chat, not necessarily one specific assistant role.
items.selection_reason: The icon combines a message shape with a bot face, so the reading is mainly conversational AI or bot messaging.

items.depicts_observation: A half-brain form connected to circuit lines and node dots, combining organic and digital visual cues.
items.popular_reading: AI reasoning, machine intelligence, or neural-style computation.
items.context_bias: Strongest in AI, inference, reasoning, automation, or intelligence features.
items.ambiguity_note: It can be read either as AI reasoning or more broadly as intelligent systems.
items.selection_reason: The hybrid of brain and circuit imagery strongly points to intelligence plus computation rather than generic hardware.

items.depicts_observation: A rounded board shape with connector nodes and trace-like lines, resembling a circuit board schematic.
items.popular_reading: Compute architecture, hardware logic, or system circuitry.
items.context_bias: Strongest in hardware, systems, architecture, developer tooling, or infrastructure views.
items.ambiguity_note: Some users may read it as generic tech rather than one exact hardware object.
items.selection_reason: The visual is clearly a board-and-trace structure, which makes the reading strongly technical and systems-oriented.
